うわ……なんだここ？ でっかい建物がこんなに!! 人も店もいっぱいすぎだろ!?
Entry.EnglishText: Whoa! What's with this place? There's so many huge buildings! Doesn’t it get crowded with all the people and shops?

Entry.JapaneseText: ウルセェよ、田舎もん！ こ、こんなのはなぁ……
Entry.EnglishText: Shut it, bumpkin! It's only so busy 'cause they're, uh...

Entry.JapaneseText: きっと、祭りでもあるんだろ
Entry.EnglishText: Probably havin' a festival or something.

Entry.JapaneseText: なるほど、祭りかぁ
Entry.EnglishText: Oh, so it’s a special occasion!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……そう、街は今日もお祭り。 無知な子羊を狙う 飢えた狼たちの、ね……
Entry.EnglishText: Pfft. Maybe for the wolves waiting for the poor lost lambs to wander straight into their gaping jaws.

Entry.JapaneseText: 人……たくさん……
Entry.EnglishText: So many... people...

Entry.JapaneseText: <Kohaku>が 怖がって仕方ねぇ。 まず宿をとって落ち着こう
Entry.EnglishText: All this excitement is probably too much for <Kohaku>. Let's hit the inn and wait for things to calm down a little.

Entry.JapaneseText: いよぉ、なんかトラブってた みたいだが、どーなった？
Entry.EnglishText: So, sounds like you ran into some trouble, what happened out there?

Entry.JapaneseText: 耳の早えーオッサンだな。 あいにく無事におさまったぜ
Entry.EnglishText: You sure caught wind of that quick. But unfortunately, they got away.

Entry.JapaneseText: ガハハ、そりゃ残念！ 儲け話の気配がしたんだがなぁ
Entry.EnglishText: Gahaha, well that’s a bummer! And here I was hopin' I'd make a more profitable outcome.

Entry.JapaneseText: 例えば、おめぇらと結晶騎士が 相討ちになって、ソーマだけが 俺の物になる……とかな！
Entry.EnglishText: Like you and those Crystal Knights wipin' each other out so I'm free to scoop up those Soma!

Entry.JapaneseText: チェンさんは『疑い、疑われる のを恐れないのがスピリアの 強さだ』って言ったよね？
Entry.EnglishText: Mr. Chen, do you remember when you said “Suspecting people and not being afraid of being suspected can be a kind of strength”?

Entry.JapaneseText: おうよ、俺の信念だぜ
Entry.EnglishText: Yup, those are the words I live by.

Entry.JapaneseText: オレは、疑うのも疑われるのも 怖かった。それはスピリアが弱い せいなのかって悩んだんだ……
Entry.EnglishText: Yknow, I was scared to doubt, and didn’t want to be doubted myself. Maybe that was because my Spiria was still too weak...

Entry.JapaneseText: けど、スピリアは、誰かを信じ 誰かに信じてもらう事でも 強くなるって、わかったんだ
Entry.EnglishText: But, I think that it’s believing in others and being trusted which makes your Spiria stronger!

Entry.JapaneseText: オレは、信じる力で スピリアを育てていくよ！
Entry.EnglishText: I will strengthen my Spiria through trust!

Entry.JapaneseText: そーかい…… だが、そりゃあ、疑うより 十倍面倒でしんどい道だぜ？
Entry.EnglishText: Is that so... but y’know, choosin’ to walk that path will be twice as hard, right?

Entry.JapaneseText: うん。 ……でも、<Kohaku>と 自分に、そう誓ったんだ
ガハハハ！ 女との約束なら 守らなきゃ男じゃねーな！
Entry.EnglishText: Gahaha! Just so you know, If you go breakin’ a promise like that to a lady, you don’t get to call yourself a man!

Entry.JapaneseText: なんだよ〜！ ボクとの約束は破ったクセにっ！
Entry.EnglishText: Hey! What about all those promises to me you broke?!

Entry.JapaneseText: いやぁ〜、おめぇが宮廷画家に なったら、本当に美術館を 建ててやっから、頑張んな！
Entry.EnglishText: Hey now, I really will build ya a museum if you can become a real court painter, so give it your best shot!

Entry.JapaneseText: うぅ〜、だまされないぞぉ〜っ！
Entry.EnglishText: Grr...You can’t fool me!

Entry.JapaneseText: こ、こりゃあ……
Entry.EnglishText: W-what was that...?

Entry.JapaneseText: スピルーンの反応！ この方向は……
Entry.EnglishText: The next Spirune! It pointed that way...

Entry.JapaneseText: 中央大陸オールドマインだな。 全世界を統べる『マクス帝国』の 帝都『エストレーガ』がある方角だ
Entry.EnglishText: That'd be the central continent, Oldmine. Looks like it was headed towards the Imperial Capital Estraga,home of the Max Empire that rules over the whole world.

Entry.JapaneseText: 最近、帝都の周辺では 街を覆うほどの デスピル病が発生中らしい
Entry.EnglishText: I’ve heard there’s been an outbreak of despir all across the capital.

Entry.JapaneseText: オールドマイン大陸行きの船は この街の南にある船着場から 出てるぜ
Entry.EnglishText: You’ll find ships bound for Oldmine at the wharfs south of town.

Entry.JapaneseText: どういうつもりさ？ あんたが、ただで 情報を教えるなんて
Entry.EnglishText: What is happening right now? There’s no way you’d give out info for free.

Entry.JapaneseText: ガハハ、未来の宮廷画家様の仲間に 冷たくすると、独占で絵を売って もらえないじゃねーか？
Entry.EnglishText: Gahaha, come now, I can’t be so cold to our future court painter. There’s no way I’d be able to snap up all her paintings then, would I?

Entry.JapaneseText: スピルーンを回収しても あのオッサンは変わらねぇなぁ
Entry.EnglishText: Sounds like that guy will never change, Spirune or no.

Entry.JapaneseText: ふん！ チェンはデスピル病と関係なく 元から疑いのかたまりなんだよ！
Entry.EnglishText: Hmph! Chen’s been super skeptical from the beginning, the despir had nothing to do with it!

Entry.JapaneseText: あいつにだけは、絶〜〜対 ボクの絵は売らないぞぉ〜ッ!!
Entry.EnglishText: I’ll never let him buy one of my paintings, ever!!

Entry.JapaneseText: けど、<Beryl>が仲間に なってくれたおかげで 情報をもらえたよ。ありがとう！
Entry.EnglishText: But you know, it was thanks to you joining us that we could get the info we needed. So thank you!

Entry.JapaneseText: あれ、どうした<Beryl>？ 顔赤いぞ!?
Entry.EnglishText: Huh, what’s the matter Beryl? Your face is so red?!

Entry.JapaneseText: う、うるさ〜〜〜い！ 勝手に仲間にしないでよッ！
Entry.EnglishText: S-shut up! Don’t think you can get all buddy buddy with me without my permission!

Entry.JapaneseText: <Shing>も、顔……真っ赤
Entry.EnglishText: Shing... your face... is red too.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……やっぱ、あいつ 性格ねじ曲がってるよな？
Entry.EnglishText: ...Has she always been this difficult?

Entry.JapaneseText: 世話になったね、女将さん！
Entry.EnglishText: Thanks for looking after us, ma’am!

Entry.JapaneseText: 女将さん…… ごはん……ごちそうさまでした
Entry.EnglishText: Thank you... for the food.

Entry.JapaneseText: あら？ <Kohaku>ちゃん 前より少し明るく なったんじゃないかい？
Entry.EnglishText: Oh? Doesn’t Kohaku seem a little brighter than she was before?

Entry.JapaneseText: うん！ 今度会う時は 絶対、もっともっと 元気になってるからね
Entry.EnglishText: Yeah! I’m sure the next time we meet, she’ll be even cheerier!

Entry.JapaneseText: またこの街に来たら、ウチの 宿を、ひいきにしてくださいよ。 若い女性は九割引きにするから
Entry.EnglishText: Next time you visit, do drop by our inn again. Ladies get 90% off!

Entry.JapaneseText: あんたぁッ！
Entry.EnglishText: Honey!

Entry.JapaneseText: <Shing>、<Kohaku>の 気配を、まだ感じるな？
Entry.EnglishText: Shing, can you still sense Kohaku?

Entry.JapaneseText: ……うん。 ここからずっと南に <Kohaku>のスピリアを感じる
Entry.EnglishText: Yeah. I can feel her Spiria way south of here.

Entry.JapaneseText: 南か……仕方ねぇ。 サンゴ船長に頼んで 船を出してもらうしかなさそうだな
Entry.EnglishText: To the south, huh. Guess we gotta ask Sango for her boating services again.

Entry.JapaneseText: 街の外は凶暴な魔物が あふれ返ってるって話だよ。 それでも行くのかい？
Entry.EnglishText: I've heard there's ferocious beasts lurking just outside of town. Just a warning to you.

Entry.JapaneseText: もちろんさ！ 元気になった <Kohaku>を連れてくるから 楽しみにしててね
Entry.EnglishText: Thanks for the heads up, but we'll be going anyway! I'm excited to see Kohaku again.

Entry.JapaneseText: きゃぁぁぁ〜〜〜ッ!!
Entry.EnglishText: Eeek!

Entry.JapaneseText: 今の声は、ラピスだ！
Entry.EnglishText: That sounded like Lapis!

Entry.JapaneseText: うわ〜〜ん、はなしてぇ!!
Entry.EnglishText: Waah, let me go!

Entry.JapaneseText: あ、あなたたちは リチアを襲った海賊！
Entry.EnglishText: Y-you're the pirates that went after Lithia!

Entry.JapaneseText: おっと、ソーマをしまえ！ 抵抗すると、てめぇの娘が どうなるかわかんねぇぞ？
Entry.EnglishText: Whoa now, put that Soma away! You wouldn't want anything to happen to your little girl, would you?

Entry.JapaneseText: や、やめて…… その子は関係ないのよ
Entry.EnglishText: S-Stop... That girl has nothing to do with this.

Entry.JapaneseText: ああん？ こいつは、お前の娘じゃねぇのか？
Entry.EnglishText: Huh? This ain't your daughter!

Entry.JapaneseText: ちがうよ！ ラピスはパパとママの子だもん！
Entry.EnglishText: No! I'm mommy and daddy's daughter!

Entry.JapaneseText: <Ines>ちゃんなんかの 子どもじゃないよ、バーーーカっ!!
Entry.EnglishText: <Ines> isn't my mom, you dummy!

Entry.JapaneseText: なんだとぉ、このガキ!!
Entry.EnglishText: Yeesh, what's with this brat?!

Entry.JapaneseText: やめてッ！ 言う通りにするから ラピスには手を出さないで
Entry.EnglishText: Stop! I'll do anything you ask, just don't hurt her!

Entry.JapaneseText: けっ、関係ねぇガキを守るってか？ 俺たちの狙いはエメラルド髪の 女だが、丁度いい……
Entry.EnglishText: Y-you still wanna protect this brat even if it ain't yours? Well, our real target is the chick with emerald hair, so this is perfect...

Entry.JapaneseText: この怪力女にも 痛めつけてくれた 礼をしてやるぜッ！
Entry.EnglishText: Time to pay you back for the walloping you gave us!

Entry.JapaneseText: あぁッ！
Entry.EnglishText: ARGH!

Entry.JapaneseText: <Ines>！ 今の音、腕の骨が!?
Entry.EnglishText: Ines! That sounded like... you arm?!

Entry.JapaneseText: <Shing>…… 手を出さないで……
Entry.EnglishText: Shing... hold out your hand...

Entry.JapaneseText: ひゃはは！ てめぇこそ手を出せねぇよう 両腕をぶち折ってやるぜぇ！
Entry.EnglishText: Hyahaha! I'll break both yer damn arms so you'll never lay a hand on us again!

Entry.JapaneseText: うぐぅ……ッ!!
Entry.EnglishText: Urk!

Entry.JapaneseText: <Ines>ちゃん！
Entry.EnglishText: Ines!

Entry.JapaneseText: 大丈夫よ、ラピス…… 私の手は折れたりしないわ
Entry.EnglishText: Don't worry, Lapis... I won't let them break me.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……あうッ！ だって、この手は ラピスのご飯を作る手……
Entry.EnglishText: ...Argh! Because I need these hands to cook your dinner...

Entry.JapaneseText: ぐッ………… あなたを抱きしめるための 手なんだからッ!!
Entry.EnglishText: Urk... I need these hands to hold you tight!!

Entry.JapaneseText: さぁ、折れるものなら 折ってみなさい！
Entry.EnglishText: So go on, do your worst!

Entry.JapaneseText: 抱きしめるための手だと……？
Entry.EnglishText: Need those hands to hold her...?

Entry.JapaneseText: くっ…… だ、だからどうしたぁ!?
Entry.EnglishText: Tch... wh-what gives?!

Entry.JapaneseText: おい、ガキ。 この女の手に触ってみろ
Entry.EnglishText: Hey, brat. Feel this dame's hand.

Entry.JapaneseText: あったけぇか？
Entry.EnglishText: Is it warm?

Entry.JapaneseText: …………うん。 ママとおなじだ……
Entry.EnglishText: ...Yeah. Just like mommy's...

Entry.JapaneseText: ……よく覚えとけ。 それが母親の ぬくもりってやつらしい
Entry.EnglishText: ...Don't forget that. That's the warmth of a mother's love right there.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……おい、リチアっていったな？ おぼれた俺を、助けてくれたのは あんたなのか？
Entry.EnglishText: ...Hey, you said Lithia right? Were you the one who saved me from drowning?

Entry.JapaneseText: ……はい
Entry.EnglishText: ...I will!

Entry.JapaneseText: そうか……夢ん中で感じた あったかさは、あんただったか……
Entry.EnglishText: I see... so that warmth I felt in my dream, it was yours...

Entry.JapaneseText: ……やめだ。 俺は引き上げるぜ
Entry.EnglishText: ...That's enough. The kid's yours.

Entry.JapaneseText: な、なんのつもりだ兄貴!?
Entry.EnglishText: W-What's gotten into you, man?!

Entry.JapaneseText: けっ、プロは奪えねぇと わかってるもんには 手を出さねぇんだ
Entry.EnglishText: Heh, pros don't try and get their mitts on things they know they can't steal.

Entry.JapaneseText: お前らが、この女のスピリアを へし折れると思うなら 続けてみりゃいいさ
Entry.EnglishText: If you really think you can break her Spiria, then be my guest.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……うっ、それは……
Entry.EnglishText: ...Uhh, well...

Entry.JapaneseText: ……ったく、むかつくぜ。 本当に欲しいもんほど 奪えやしねぇときてる……
Entry.EnglishText: ...It pisses me off, not being able to get what I really want...

Entry.JapaneseText: ううっ……
Entry.EnglishText: Ugh...

Entry.JapaneseText: <Ines>ちゃん！
Entry.EnglishText: Ines!

Entry.JapaneseText: 『ナミダとイタイの半分っこ！ かなしいコトも半分っこ！ 半分半分、ラピスにうつれ!! 』
Entry.EnglishText: "Half of your tears and half of your fears―Share them with me and you'll feel free!!"

Entry.JapaneseText: ……ラピス？
Entry.EnglishText: ...Lapis?

Entry.JapaneseText: ママがおしえてくれた呪文だよ。 いつもママは、こうやって イタイのを半分っこしてくれたの
Entry.EnglishText: It's a magic spell mommy taught me. She always takes away half my pain like this.

Entry.JapaneseText: ごめんね……ごめんね…… ラピスのせいでイタかったでしょ？
Entry.EnglishText: I'm sorry... I'm so sorry... it's my fault you got hurt, right?

Entry.JapaneseText: ……ううん。 ラピスの呪文のおかげで、痛いの 全部どこかへ行っちゃったわ
Entry.EnglishText: ...That's not true. All my pain flew away thanks to your magic spell.

Entry.JapaneseText: あのね、<Ines>ちゃん…… さっきのピザたべてもいい？
Entry.EnglishText: Um, Ines...? Can I... eat the pizza you made?

Entry.JapaneseText: ……でも、コゲコゲよ？
Entry.EnglishText: ...Even though it's all burnt?

Entry.JapaneseText: いいの。 ……ホントはね、ママのピザも ときどきコゲコゲだったの
Entry.EnglishText: It's okay... Sometimes mommy's pizza gets burnt too.

Entry.JapaneseText: でも、パパは『みんなでたべれば コゲコゲでもおいしいよ』って いってた
Entry.EnglishText: But daddy says "it'll still be yummy if we all eat it together,"

Entry.JapaneseText: ラピスもそうおもうよ。 だから、<Ines>ちゃんも……
Entry.EnglishText: I think so too. So, will you...?

Entry.JapaneseText: ……うん、一緒に食べましょう
Entry.EnglishText: ...Of course, let's eat it together.

Entry.JapaneseText: パパとママの想いも あなたを見守って ずっと一緒にいてくれるわ
Entry.EnglishText: Mommy and daddy's love will always be with you to keep you safe.

Entry.JapaneseText: ラピスの事は、あたしが 責任を持ってあずかるよ
Entry.EnglishText: I'll take good care of Lapis.

Entry.JapaneseText: お願いします、女将さん
Entry.EnglishText: Thank you so much.

Entry.JapaneseText: ラピス、パパとママのお話し…… ちょっとだけ 待ってくれないかしら？
Entry.EnglishText: Lapis, about your mommy and daddy... could you wait a little while longer?

Entry.JapaneseText: あなたが、もう少し お姉さんになったら、必ず 本当の事を話すって約束するから
Entry.EnglishText: When you're a bit older, I promise I'll tell you everything.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……うん。ラピスは もう赤ちゃんじゃないから がまんできるよ
Entry.EnglishText: ...Okay. I'm not a little baby anymore, so I can wait.

Entry.JapaneseText: でもね…… ひとつだけきいてもいい？
Entry.EnglishText: But, um... can I ask you one question?
...What?

Entry.JapaneseText: <Ines>ちゃんは ラピスのパパとママのこと…… ……すきだったよね？
Entry.EnglishText: Mommy and daddy... you love them right?

Entry.JapaneseText: ……もちろんよ。 そして、ラピス—— あなたの事も大好きよ
Entry.EnglishText: ...Of course I do. Not just them--I love you too, Lapis.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……これあげる
Entry.EnglishText: ...Take this.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……なんて きれいな宝石……
Entry.EnglishText: ...What a pretty stone...

Entry.JapaneseText: パパがママに、ママがラピスに くれた宝物なの。だいじな人を まもるお守りなんだよ
Entry.EnglishText: This is a special treasure daddy gave to mommy, then mommy gave to me. It's a special amulet that protects the people you love.

Entry.JapaneseText: いってらっしゃい <Ines>ちゃん…… はやくかえってきてね
Entry.EnglishText: Bye bye Ines... come back soon.

Entry.JapaneseText: ええ、すぐに帰ってくるわ！ ガルデニアなんて、素手で カチ割っちゃうんだからッ!!
Entry.EnglishText: Yes, I'll be back before you know it! I'll crack Gardenia in half with my own two hands!!

Entry.JapaneseText: あはは、今の<Ines>なら 本当にできそうだね？
Entry.EnglishText: Haha, seeing you now I'd totally believe it.

Entry.JapaneseText: おかみさん、ラピスにも おりょうりおしえてね
Entry.EnglishText: Ma'am, can you teach me how to cook?

Entry.JapaneseText: <Ines>ちゃんは おりょうりヘタみたいだから ラピスがしっかりしなきゃ！
Entry.EnglishText: Ines doesn't seem very good at it, so I need to know how!

Entry.JapaneseText: それはないわよ、ラピスぅ……
Entry.EnglishText: H-Hey now...

Entry.JapaneseText: きみたち、無事に戻ったか！
Entry.EnglishText: You guys are all right!

Entry.JapaneseText: 当り前だ！ 狩場の魔物は狩ってきたぜ
Entry.EnglishText: Of course we are! We mopped up all the monsters.

Entry.JapaneseText: おお、ありがとう！ これで多くの人たちが 救われるよ
Entry.EnglishText: Ahh, I can't thank you enough! What you've done today will surely help many people.

Entry.JapaneseText: ふっふ〜ん！ 末永〜くほめたたえてよね♪
Entry.EnglishText: Hehehe! Dooo go on! ♪

Entry.JapaneseText: もちろんだとも！ これはお礼だよ
Entry.EnglishText: Of course! Anything we can do to repay you.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……でも、凶暴化してるのは 狩場の魔物たちだけじゃないよ。 みんな十分注意してね
Entry.EnglishText: ...But it's not just the hunting grounds that are getting more dangerous. Please take care out there.

Entry.JapaneseText: よ〜し 夕飯の献立も決まったし 帰って昼寝でもするかねぇ♪
Entry.EnglishText: Now that's I've got dinner sorted, I think I'll head home and take an afternoon nap! ♪

Entry.JapaneseText: あんたらも、あんまり 親を困らせんじゃないよ！
Entry.EnglishText: You boys be good, now!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……おっと、ハーブを 買いすぎちまったんだ。 あんたらにあげるよ！
Entry.EnglishText: ...Oh, silly me. I bought way too many herbs. Here, take some!
